thread:
Diana M: quick sync — proposing a lightweight regression gate for new quant builds. TL;DR: small-sample semantic eval + traffic canary + automated fail criteria.

Ben K: +1 — can you sketch exact checks? we need something that CI can run and ops can monitor.

Diana M: plan
1) offline eval harness: run prompt-suite A (1000 prompts, mix of instruction+chit) and compute embed-sim mean & median + pass rate on task-specific correctness
2) delta thresholds: <= 2% drop on pass-rate OR <= 0.015 drop on mean embed-sim => FAIL
3) statistical test: bootstrap 10k samples to compute 95% CI for mean diff (baseline vs candidate), require CI upper bound < threshold to pass
4) smoke latency & token-stability tests (no >3% increase p50 latency, no token anomalies)
5) canary: 1% traffic for 24h with automated rollback if error-rate >1% or user-quality score < baseline-0.03

Alice R: a couple clarifications:
- prompt-suite A is the standard regression set right? size and genres?

Diana M: yes — suite A = instruction/QA(500), summarization(200), code(150), chit/clarity(150). We also run separate toxicity & safety quick-check (50 samples) — must see no new high-risk categories.

Cory L: for embed-sim metric, which model/encoder do we use as reference? tiny differences in encoder can change numbers.

Diana M: use prod-embed-enc v3 (stable) for all comparisons. We store vector snapshots in eval-bucket and compute cosine similarity. Documented in eval-harness README.

Ben K: on sample sizes — 1000 prompts seems fine, but bootstrap 10k is heavy. Could we do 2k bootstrap rounds in CI and full 10k in nightly eval for candidates that pass CI?

Eva (eval-bot): auto-note: CI-run config suggestion -> 2k bootstrap rounds in PR pipeline; full 10k in nightly. See job: ci/eval/quant-smoke.

Diana M: agreed. Add additional gating: any single task (e.g., code) drop >4% fail-rate triggers manual review even if overall pass-rate within threshold.

Alice R: how do we detect token anomalies? examples?

Cory L: token anomalies = repeating loops, hallucinated signatures, truncated completions mid-sentence compared to baseline. We can detect via heuristics: repetition ratio > 3x baseline OR token-length deviation > 30% for summarization.

Diana M: include the heuristic checks as quick smoke tests with sample outputs attached. Use `diff-output` script to produce short report. Example command:
```
./tools/run_eval.sh --suite suiteA --baseline prod-2026-02-01 --candidate candidate-quant-0.9 --bootstrap 2000 --metrics embed_sim,pass_rate,latency
```

Ben K: CI reporting: adapt the existing eval dashboard to surface the CI delta + bootstrapped CI. Also add a small human-readable summary in the PR status for reviewers.

Eva (eval-bot): PR comment template ready: "Eval smoke: PASS/FAIL — overall delta: -0.008 embed_sim (95% CI: -0.012..-0.004) — tasks flagged: code (3.8% drop) — action: manual review required".

Diana M: canary config: deploy-bot please create canary route with 1% traffic, 24h auto-monitor for these signals: error-rate, user-quality-proxy (heuristic), latency p50/p95. Rollback policy: immediate if error-rate >1% sustained for 10m OR quality-proxy drop >0.03 sustained for 30m.

deploy-bot: created canary: redwood-canary-quant-197246. Monitoring hooks added. Alerts wired to #incidents and oncall.

Alice R: who signs off manual review? ML lead + Product eng? suggest: ML owner (Diana) + Eng owner + PM when user-facing impact.

Diana M: yes — signoff = ML lead + Eng owner. If safety flags appear also include security/compliance.

Ben K: ok let's get this documented as a short checklist and add it to the model-intake page. I'll draft the PR with config snippets.

Diana M: thanks. Action items: Ben -> PR with CI job + dashboard change. Alice -> add prompt-suite metadata & sampling code. Cory -> heuristics for token anomalies. Eva -> ensure PR comment template wired. I'll own the manual review flow.

Ben K: ETA EOD tomorrow for PR draft.

Alice R: starting prompt-suite metadata now.

Cory L: I'll sketch heuristics by EOD.

Eva (eval-bot): noted tasks and ETA; will ping when PR comment template is live.

Diana M: awesome. If anyone wants to review the threshold numbers ping me. :thumbsup:
